snippet.title: The Guild: Europa 1410 - Official City Showcase Trailer
snippet.description: Don't miss the City Showcase Trailer for The Guild: Europa 1410, a sandbox strategy RPG developed by Ashborne Games. Players will rise above the rest in medieval Europe by way of mastering their profession. Get a look at the scenic views around the city in The Guild: Europa 1410, coming soon to PC (Steam).
